project.title: Mainstream anammox enables high-rate nitrogen and phosphorus removal from low-COD/N municipal wastewater in a biofilm-enhanced A2/O process
project.description: A continuous-flow anaerobic/anoxic/oxic reactor with integrated fixed-film activated sludge (A2/O-IFAS) treated real low-COD/N municipal wastewater for 500 days without external carbon. Floc sludge, anoxic carrier biofilm and oxic carrier biofilm were sampled on days 1, 116, 400 and 500, and the V3-V4 region of the bacterial 16S rRNA gene was sequenced (Illumina MiSeq PE300) to characterize the microbial communities, including anammox bacteria, nitrifiers and phosphorus-accumulating organisms.
